posts.name: Johnny
posts.cooked: Can you explain how Circle would be able to freeze DAI? Geniunely asking to understand the risk.

Is funny to see this, ppl think is just a problem for Maker. Maker is one of the BIGGEST USDC holders, if Circle blacklist Maker: first will shoot at its own foot. Second the entire DeFi will break, I’m not talking about a Terra Catastrophe, I’m talking that you guys should go and change everything for Bitcoin or Fiat cuz we’ll be f*cked (all of us).

Still yeah, Maker needs to make DAI more decentralized again, but lets not freak out for this.

This is my lay understanding, so it’s subject to rebuttal by more knowledgeable developers, but essentially:

  • MakerDAO has a smart contract, the PSM, with billions of DAI and USDC in it.
  • Also/relatedly, MakerDAO is associated with thousands of Vaults with USDC that have been used as collateral for issuance of millions or billions of DAI.

Circle could add the addresses of all Maker Vaults containing DAI and the PSM to it’s blacklist. Because any transactions [edit: involving USDC], including PSM and liquidation transactions require interacting with the USDC Smart Contract, and because that smart contract would no longer accept such interactions, those vaults would no longer be liquidatable, and there would no longer be a reliable exit point from DAI to USDC (and implicitly, to fiat).

So while DAI transactions could continue, the DAI itself would no longer be collateralized the same way.

Also, any liquidity pools that held both DAI and USDC would potentially stop functioning, and DAI in those pools could be directly frozen.
